title: Assessing Historical Structural Oppression Worldwide via Rule-Guided Prompting of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with individuals' self-identified ethnicity and country of residence to generate a historical structural oppression score (1-5), and comparing these model-generated scores against human expert annotations to identify inaccuracies and built-in model biases, such as overestimating severity, stereotyping, or misinterpreting ambiguous identities.
